summary: RELATE is a self-hosted Django web-based courseware/LMS: instructors create git-backed courses, students enroll into Participations with role-based permissions, work through git-versioned FlowSessions of pages, submit answers that get auto/manual graded into FlowPageVisitGrade and aggregated into GradeChange records, exams are gated by ticket codes, and courses/events/tokens/messages are all persisted as Django models.
